/i18n/en.ui.app.needs.etcd: Nothing to enable: etcd serves metrics on its client URL; with TLS or listen-metrics-urls, give that address.
/i18n/en.ui.app.needs.grafana: Nothing to enable: Grafana serves /metrics by default. Open it only to the monitoring host.
/i18n/en.ui.app.needs.haproxy: Serve the built-in Prometheus exporter at /metrics (http-request use-service prometheus-exporter), open only to the monitoring host.

/i18n/en.ui.app.needs.php-fpm: Set pm.status_path in the pool and route that path to PHP-FPM, open only to the monitoring host.
/i18n/en.ui.app.needs.prometheus: Nothing to enable: Prometheus serves its own metrics at /metrics; open only to the monitoring host.
/i18n/en.ui.app.needs.rabbitmq: Enable the rabbitmq_prometheus plugin; it serves port 15692.
/i18n/en.ui.app.needs.traefik: Turn on the Prometheus metrics (metrics.prometheus) with their own entry point; 8082 is the usual port.

/i18n/en.ui.opt.aa: Authoritative only — yes accepts only answers with the AA bit set

/i18n/en.ui.opt.allow-metadata: Allow cloud metadata — yes lets the check reach an address such as 169.254.169.254
/i18n/en.ui.opt.app: Application — which status page profile to read
/i18n/en.ui.opt.attempts: Attempts — failed checks in a row before it is a problem
/i18n/en.ui.opt.auth: SNMPv3 authentication — md5, sha, sha256 or sha512; needs user= and auth-pass=
/i18n/en.ui.opt.auth-pass: SNMPv3 authentication password — at least 8 characters; keep it in a secret
/i18n/en.ui.opt.authorized: Authorized — UDP checks only: yes when the target is your own device. DNS, NTP and SNMP replies can be abused for reflection attacks; without it the configuration shows a warning
/i18n/en.ui.opt.basic: Basic login — user:password for HTTP basic authentication
/i18n/en.ui.opt.bearer: Bearer token — sent as Authorization: Bearer …
/i18n/en.ui.opt.body: Request body — sent with POST or PUT
/i18n/en.ui.opt.cert-critical-days: Certificate critical days — failed when the certificate expires within this many days
/i18n/en.ui.opt.cert-days: Certificate warning days — degraded when the certificate expires within this many days
/i18n/en.ui.opt.change: Sudden change — warn when the value moves more than this from the reference (compare=), such as 50%
/i18n/en.ui.opt.community: SNMP community — v1/v2c password; keep it in a secret
/i18n/en.ui.opt.compare: Reference for change= — previous (the sample before, default), 24h or 7d (the median around that time earlier); a minute or less means previous; learns until it has one
/i18n/en.ui.opt.count: Ping count — echo requests per check
/i18n/en.ui.opt.crit: Critical limit — above this the check fails; must lie further out than warn on the same side; unit as for warn
/i18n/en.ui.opt.critical-days: Critical days — failed when the domain expires within this many days
/i18n/en.ui.opt.days: Warning days — degraded when the domain expires within this many days
/i18n/en.ui.opt.degraded: Slow threshold — slower than this is shown as degraded
/i18n/en.ui.opt.direction: Direction for change= — up (rises only), down (falls only) or both (default)
/i18n/en.ui.opt.expect: Expected answer — HTTP: the status code (200-399). SNMP: a number must equal it exactly, a text must contain it. DNS: an address or name must equal it (case and the final dot ignored), an MX or TXT answer must contain it
/i18n/en.ui.opt.expect-all: Expect all — every one of these addresses must be in the answer
/i18n/en.ui.opt.expect-hex: Expected bytes (hex) — the reply must start with these bytes
/i18n/en.ui.opt.expect-len: Expected length — the reply must be this many bytes
/i18n/en.ui.opt.expect-num: Number check — compares the number read: > 0, <= 80, = 5. Only for a number; to compare a text use expect=
/i18n/en.ui.opt.expect-program: RPC program — the program number the portmapper must list
/i18n/en.ui.opt.expect-regex: Expected pattern — the reply must match this regular expression
/i18n/en.ui.opt.fallback: TCP fallback — when this host cannot send ICMP, knock on TCP 443, 80 and 22 instead (default); off turns it off
/i18n/en.ui.opt.family: IP version — 4 or 6, to check over one of them only
/i18n/en.ui.opt.field: Number judged — one of the application's numbers; the profile's main one when empty
/i18n/en.ui.opt.for: Lasting for — a breach counts only after it has lasted this long, such as 5m
/i18n/en.ui.opt.grace: Grace — how late a push may be before it is a problem
/i18n/en.ui.opt.handler: Event handler — script from the check-scripts directory run on each state change
/i18n/en.ui.opt.header.Authorization: Request header — header.Name=value adds a header
/i18n/en.ui.opt.host: Host header — the name sent to the server, for a target given as an address
/i18n/en.ui.opt.host-check: Host check — when the UDP port stays silent, count it as open only while the host answers a ping; off accepts silence alone

/i18n/en.ui.opt.json-expect: JSON expected — the value at the JSON path, written as text, must equal this exactly (1 and 1.0 differ; use json-expect-num for numbers)

/i18n/en.ui.opt.json-path: JSON path — the value to check in a JSON reply, such as $.status

/i18n/en.ui.opt.keyword-regex: Keyword pattern — the page must match this regular expression
/i18n/en.ui.opt.loss: Loss threshold — percent lost before it fails

/i18n/en.ui.opt.no-follow: Do not follow redirects — yes to check the redirect itself
/i18n/en.ui.opt.oid: OID — the SNMP object to read
/i18n/en.ui.opt.on-filtered: When this host's firewall blocks — fail (default) or abstain when this host's own firewall refuses to send the request. A remote firewall that drops it shows as a timeout instead

/i18n/en.ui.opt.password: Password — keep it in a secret
/i18n/en.ui.opt.period: Expected every — how often the push should arrive
/i18n/en.ui.opt.port: Network port — the switch or router port by name, such as Gi0/1; reads its traffic, speed and state, and fails while it is down
/i18n/en.ui.opt.priv: SNMPv3 privacy (encryption) — des or aes; needs auth= and priv-pass=
/i18n/en.ui.opt.priv-pass: SNMPv3 privacy password — at least 8 characters; keep it in a secret
/i18n/en.ui.opt.profile: Sensor table — entity (standard, default), huawei, h3c or cisco
/i18n/en.ui.opt.proxy: Proxy — HTTP proxy to go through
/i18n/en.ui.opt.qtype: Record type — A, AAAA, MX, TXT …
/i18n/en.ui.opt.query: Query — one SELECT; the number in its first column of the first row is judged
/i18n/en.ui.opt.rdap: RDAP server — address of the RDAP service to ask
/i18n/en.ui.opt.recover-attempts: Recovery attempts — good checks in a row before it counts as recovered
/i18n/en.ui.opt.recurse: Recursion — no to ask an authoritative server directly
/i18n/en.ui.opt.retransmit: Retransmissions — how often an unanswered UDP request is sent again within one check (0–5, default 1)
/i18n/en.ui.opt.retry: Retry interval — how soon to check again after a failure
/i18n/en.ui.opt.role: Redis role — master, replica or sentinel the server must have
/i18n/en.ui.opt.rtt: Round-trip limit — slower replies count as degraded
/i18n/en.ui.opt.scope: Network scope — lan or wan; wan checks are held back while this host's own internet is down
/i18n/en.ui.opt.select: Narrow to one thing — label=value on a metrics page, such as proxy=www for one HAProxy proxy
/i18n/en.ui.opt.send: Send — text sent after connecting (\r\n for line breaks)
/i18n/en.ui.opt.send-hex: Send (hex) — bytes sent after connecting, in hexadecimal
/i18n/en.ui.opt.sensor: Temperature sensor — by name, such as Inlet; reads °C from the device
/i18n/en.ui.opt.servername: TLS server name — the name sent in TLS (SNI)
/i18n/en.ui.opt.service: gRPC service — the service name for the health check
/i18n/en.ui.opt.socket: Docker socket — path of the Docker socket
/i18n/en.ui.opt.src-port: Source port — send from this local port, for devices that only answer a fixed source port
/i18n/en.ui.opt.ssl: SSL — yes to connect with TLS
/i18n/en.ui.opt.template: Protocol template — which protocol to speak, such as dns, ntp, snmp or raw; by default the port decides
/i18n/en.ui.opt.timeout: Timeout — how long one check may take before it counts as failed
/i18n/en.ui.opt.tls: TLS — yes to connect with TLS and watch the certificate
/i18n/en.ui.opt.user: User name — for SNMPv3 (version=3), and for the database and Redis checks
/i18n/en.ui.opt.value: Port value judged — only with port=: util (% of the port speed), in or out (bits per second); other checks judge the one number they read

/tunables.desc_zh: 每个令牌或来源 IP 的 API 请求速率

/tunables.desc: policy change notices go through when a change names neither a policy nor channels (empty = system policy)
/tunables.desc_zh: 变更未指定策略或通道时，变更通知使用的策略（留空 = 系统策略）

/tunables.desc: reminders before an announced change starts, comma separated (empty = none)
/tunables.desc_zh: 已发布的变更开始前提醒的时间点，逗号分隔（留空 = 不提醒）

/tunables.desc: clock skew beyond which time-sensitive votes abstain
/tunables.desc_zh: 节点时钟偏差超过多少，时间相关检查的票改为弃权

/tunables.desc: no effect since 2.2: there are no agents; a site that loses the master says so itself; kept so older settings load
/tunables.desc_zh: 自 2.2 起不再生效：已没有 Agent，站点联系不上主节点时会自己通知；保留只为兼容旧设置

/tunables.desc: how long a join code can be used
/tunables.desc_zh: 加入码的有效期

/tunables.desc: join, rejoin and retire requests, and node requests without a valid token, per client IP (kept apart from sign-ins)
/tunables.desc_zh: 每个来源 IP 的加入、重新加入、退位请求及未带有效令牌的节点请求速率（与登录分开计算）

/tunables.desc: largest agent protocol message in bytes
/tunables.desc_zh: Agent 协议单条消息的最大字节数

/tunables.desc: agent disconnected this long is offline
/tunables.desc_zh: Agent 断开多久判为离线

/tunables.desc: how often every node checks that it can reach the other nodes (majority node status)
/tunables.desc_zh: 每个节点多久检查一次能否连接其他节点（多数派判断节点状态）

/tunables.desc: how often the master pings each agent; three missed intervals end the session
/tunables.desc_zh: Master 多久 ping 一次 Agent；连续三个周期没有响应则断开会话

/tunables.desc: no effect since 2.2: every site checks and alerts on its own at all times; kept so older settings load
/tunables.desc_zh: 自 2.2 起不再生效：每个站点始终独立检查和告警；保留只为兼容旧设置

/tunables.desc: wait before a standby tries again after a failed copy of the master's state (three times at most)
/tunables.desc_zh: 备用节点复制主节点状态失败后，再次尝试前的等待时间（最多三次）

/tunables.desc: how often standbys fetch a copy of the master's state (also after every configuration change)
/tunables.desc_zh: 备用节点拉取主节点状态副本的间隔（每次配置变更后也会拉取）

/tunables.desc: after start, hold minority and node-down notices this long while agents reconnect
/tunables.desc_zh: 启动后这段时间内暂缓少数派/节点离线告警，等待 Agent 重连

/tunables.desc: no effect since 2.2: there are no agents to wait for; kept so older settings load
/tunables.desc_zh: 自 2.2 起不再生效：已没有 Agent；保留只为兼容旧设置

/tunables.desc: times an address may be refused as nonexistent (unknown mailbox, invalid number) before it is no longer sent to; 0 keeps sending
/tunables.desc_zh: 地址被判定为不存在（邮箱不存在、号码无效）多少次后停止向它发送；0 表示继续发送

/tunables.desc: tell a team's administrators (once a day per channel) when e-mail or SMS recipients are left out because they are not active contacts
/tunables.desc_zh: 收件人因不在通讯录或非在职状态被跳过时，通知团队管理员（每个渠道每天一次）

/tunables.desc: consecutive slow rounds before DEGRADED (0 = use attempts)
/tunables.desc_zh: 连续几轮变慢判为 DEGRADED（0 = 与 attempts 相同）

/tunables.desc: how long a failed monitor waits for its parents to be re-checked before it notifies
/tunables.desc_zh: 监控项失败后，等待其父监控项复查的最长时间，超时后照常通知

/tunables.desc: first round after a monitor is created or redefined
/tunables.desc_zh: 新建或定义变更后，首轮检查的最长等待

/tunables.desc: how long an event handler may run before it is killed
/tunables.desc_zh: 事件处理脚本最长运行时间，超时即终止

/tunables.desc: no effect since 2.2: every site alerts on its own; kept so older settings load
/tunables.desc_zh: 自 2.2 起不再生效：每个站点各自告警；保留只为兼容旧设置

/tunables.desc: warn when one change sends more monitors back to PENDING
/tunables.desc_zh: 一次变更导致多少个监控项进入 PENDING 时提示

/tunables.desc: consecutive OK rounds needed to recover from HARD
/tunables.desc_zh: HARD 状态下连续正常几轮才算恢复

/tunables.desc: extra time after timeout before a round is closed
/tunables.desc_zh: 一轮在超时之外额外等待上报的时间

/tunables.desc: how often the external heartbeat (dead man's switch) URL is called
/tunables.desc_zh: 外部心跳（死人开关）的调用间隔

/tunables.desc: timeout of one external heartbeat call
/tunables.desc_zh: 单次外部心跳调用的超时

/tunables.desc: a gateway that never answered within this time is not used as an anchor
/tunables.desc_zh: 启动后此时长内从未应答的路由器不作锚点

/tunables.desc: consecutive anchor failures before the path is considered down
/tunables.desc_zh: 锚点连续失败几次才判定该路径中断

/tunables.desc: anchor (gateway) check interval
/tunables.desc_zh: 锚点（路由器）检查间隔

/tunables.desc: consecutive anchor successes before the path is considered up again
/tunables.desc_zh: 锚点连续成功几次才判定恢复

/tunables.desc: failures that began this long before a local outage was recognised, and that nobody was told about yet, are attributed to it
/tunables.desc_zh: 本机断网被识别前多长时间内开始、且尚未通知任何人的故障，归入这次断网

/tunables.desc: distinct names failing resolution (while the network works) before the local resolver is judged broken
/tunables.desc_zh: 网络正常但至少这么多个不同域名解析失败时，判定本机 DNS 异常

/tunables.desc: a wan failure domain counts as available evidence when it was probed within this time
/tunables.desc_zh: 外网故障域在此时长内被探测过才计入可用证据

/tunables.desc: local network anomaly detection
/tunables.desc_zh: 本机网络异常检测（断网时暂停判定）

/tunables.desc: share of wan targets (healthy before the outage) that must recover to exit
/tunables.desc_zh: 退出判定：断网前正常的外网目标中恢复的占比

/tunables.desc: internet address pinged, once an internet target fails, to show on the path view whether this host gets out to the internet; display only, it never holds alerts (empty = off)
/tunables.desc_zh: 外网网关探测地址：有外网目标失败时才 ping，在路径图上显示本机能否出外网；只用于显示，不参与告警抑制（留空 = 关闭）

/tunables.desc: consecutive healthy windows required to exit
/tunables.desc_zh: 退出判定需要连续满足的窗口数

/tunables.desc: reuse a pre-HARD self-check result for this long
/tunables.desc_zh: 即时自检结果的复用时长

/tunables.desc: recently healthy wan targets re-checked before a network-class failure turns HARD
/tunables.desc_zh: 转 HARD 前即时自检重测的近期正常外网目标数

/tunables.desc: timeout of the pre-HARD self-check probes
/tunables.desc_zh: 转 HARD 前即时自检的探测超时

/tunables.desc: add a ping monitor for the LAN gateway and one for localnet.exit-target, once the configuration has monitors of its own; a deleted one is not added again
/tunables.desc_zh: 已有自己的监控项后，自动为内网网关和外网网关（localnet.exit-target）各添加一个 ping 监控；删掉的不会再加回来

/tunables.desc: a local outage longer than this stops holding monitors back, in case the judgement is wrong (0 = never)
/tunables.desc_zh: 本机断网超过此时长后不再压住监控告警（以防误判），0 表示不限

/tunables.desc: independent failure domains (IPv4 /24, IPv6 /48, registrable domain) that must fail before the uplink is judged down; fewer wan domains = detection off
/tunables.desc_zh: 判定监控机外网中断至少需要的独立故障域数（IPv4 /24、IPv6 /48、同一注册域名）；外网故障域少于此数时不做自动判定

/tunables.desc: outages shorter than this are recorded but not notified
/tunables.desc_zh: 短于此时长的断网只记事件、不发通知

/tunables.desc: after a local outage, the re-checks of the monitors it hid are spread over this time
/tunables.desc_zh: 断网恢复后，对被压住的监控的复检分散在这段时间内进行

/tunables.desc: internet reference points, in different networks, asked on TCP 443 whenever an internet target fails: if any answers this host's network works and the failure is the target's; if none does, together with the targets they show this host's own uplink is down (empty = off)
/tunables.desc_zh: 互联网参照点（不同网络中的地址）：有外网目标失败时连它们的 TCP 443；任何一个能连上就说明本机网络正常、是目标自己的故障；全部连不上时，和失败的目标一起证明本机外网断了（留空 = 关闭）

/tunables.desc: window in which any wan network-layer success vetoes the uplink-down judgement
/tunables.desc_zh: 否决窗口：窗口内任一外网目标网络层成功即否决断网判定

/tunables.desc: alerts one person (or one chat room) is sent per window; when anyone an alert goes to has had this many, the whole alert waits for one summary listing every held alert (0 = off). Problems, reminders, escalations and recoveries all count, each once per person; system notices always go out
/tunables.desc_zh: 每个人（或每个群）在一个窗口内最多收到几条告警；一条告警的任何一个接收者已达到这个数，整条告警就暂缓，之后合成一条汇总逐条列出（0 为关闭）。问题、重复提醒、升级、恢复都计入，每条告警对每个人只算一次；系统通知始终直接发送

/tunables.desc: the window of notify.backstop-max; a summary goes out this long after the first alert it holds
/tunables.desc_zh: notify.backstop-max 的统计窗口；汇总在其中第一条暂缓告警之后这么久发出

/tunables.desc: per-channel send rate limit
/tunables.desc_zh: 单个通道的发送速率上限

/tunables.desc: extra retries per channel on temporary failure before falling back (0 keeps prior no-retry behaviour)
/tunables.desc_zh: 通道临时失败时的额外重试次数（之后走备援；显式 0 表示不重试）

/tunables.desc: per-channel delivery timeout
/tunables.desc_zh: 单个通道的投递超时

/tunables.desc: queued messages per channel before the rest is merged into one digest
/tunables.desc_zh: 通道排队超过多少条后，其余合并为一条摘要

/tunables.desc: max queue wait before the rest is merged into one digest
/tunables.desc_zh: 排队超过多长时间后，其余合并为一条摘要

/tunables.desc: daily reminder of still-open incidents
/tunables.desc_zh: 每日提醒仍未解决的故障

/tunables.desc: local time of the daily open-incident reminder
/tunables.desc_zh: 每日未解决故障提醒的时间

/tunables.desc: daily status report: hosts down and up, services not OK
/tunables.desc_zh: 每日状态日报：哪些主机宕机、哪些正常，哪些服务异常

/tunables.desc: local times of the daily status report, one to four, comma-separated (09:00,17:00)
/tunables.desc_zh: 每日状态日报的发送时间，1 到 4 个，逗号分隔（09:00,17:00）

/tunables.desc: entries listed per report section before the rest is counted
/tunables.desc_zh: 日报每节最多列出的条目数，其余只计数

/tunables.desc: policy the daily report is sent through (empty = system policy)
/tunables.desc_zh: 日报使用的通知策略（留空 = 系统策略）

/tunables.desc: teams receiving the daily report, each on its own monitors (comma-separated)
/tunables.desc_zh: 接收日报的团队（逗号分隔），每个团队收到自己监控的日报

/tunables.desc: notifications per low-priority (DEGRADED/regional) incident
/tunables.desc_zh: 低优先级故障（变慢、区域性故障）的通知上限

/tunables.desc: delay before the first notification
/tunables.desc_zh: 首次通知前的延迟

/tunables.desc: an alert no channel delivered is sent again after this long (doubled each time, up to the repeat interval) and does not count towards notify.max; 0 leaves it to the repeat interval
/tunables.desc_zh: 所有通道都没送达的告警在此时长后重发（每次翻倍，不超过重复通知间隔），且不计入 notify.max；0 表示只按重复通知间隔

/tunables.desc: monitors failing to resolve their names together before a summary blames DNS instead of the services
/tunables.desc_zh: 至少多少个监控同时域名解析失败，汇总才判定为 DNS 问题而非业务问题

/tunables.desc: deliveries later than this are tagged [delayed]
/tunables.desc_zh: 晚于此时长补发的通知加 [延迟] 标记

/tunables.desc: problem notifications per incident before going quiet (0 = unlimited)
/tunables.desc_zh: 每个故障最多发送几条问题通知后封顶（0 = 不限）

/tunables.desc: a new HARD failure within this window reopens the previous incident
/tunables.desc_zh: 故障重开窗口：恢复后此时间内再次故障则重开原故障

/tunables.desc: repeat interval for open, unacknowledged incidents
/tunables.desc_zh: 未确认故障的重复通知间隔

/tunables.desc: longest wait a rate-limiting service may ask for that is waited out on the same channel; a longer one sends the message on to the next channel
/tunables.desc_zh: 服务方限流时要求的等待时间不超过此值，就在原通道等待后重试；超过则改走下一个通道

/tunables.desc: wait before the first channel retry; the second uses 5s when this stays at the default 2s
/tunables.desc_zh: 首次通道重试前的等待；默认 2s 时第二次为 5s

/tunables.desc: messages a minute each chat service takes from one robot or webhook (kind=N, comma separated); a channel never sends more, whatever its rate
/tunables.desc_zh: 各聊天服务对单个机器人或 webhook 每分钟接收的消息数上限（kind=N，逗号分隔）；通道发送不会超过它，无论 rate 设多大

/tunables.desc: weekly report of the last seven days: availability, problems and downtime, the least available monitors, alerts held back
/tunables.desc_zh: 每周报告（最近 7 天）：可用率、故障次数与时长、可用率最低的监控、拦下的无效告警

/tunables.desc: day and local time of the weekly report (mon 09:00)
/tunables.desc_zh: 每周报告的发送日和时间（mon 09:00）

/tunables.desc: no effect: on-call rotations were removed; kept so old $SET lines stay valid
/tunables.desc_zh: 已无作用：值班表功能已移除；保留此项是为了让旧的 $SET 行仍然有效

/tunables.desc: no effect: on-call rotations were removed; kept so old $SET lines stay valid
/tunables.desc_zh: 已无作用：值班表功能已移除；保留此项是为了让旧的 $SET 行仍然有效

/tunables.desc: TLS certificates expiring within this many days fail HTTPS and TLS checks unless the monitor sets cert-critical-days (0 = off); expired ones always fail
/tunables.desc_zh: 证书在多少天内到期时，HTTPS/TLS 检查判为故障（监控项可用 cert-critical-days 覆盖；0 关闭）；已过期的证书一律判为故障

/tunables.desc: TLS certificates expiring within this many days mark HTTPS and TLS checks DEGRADED unless the monitor sets cert-days (0 = off)
/tunables.desc_zh: 证书在多少天内到期时，HTTPS/TLS 检查显示为性能下降（监控项可用 cert-days 覆盖；0 关闭）

/tunables.desc: minimum spacing of manual 'check now' per monitor
/tunables.desc_zh: 同一监控项“立即检查”的最小间隔

/tunables.desc: DNS servers the checks ask, comma-separated (empty = this host's own settings)
/tunables.desc_zh: 检查使用的 DNS 服务器，多个用逗号分隔（留空 = 使用本机设置）

/tunables.desc: evidence samples kept per monitor and node
/tunables.desc_zh: 每个“监控项 × 节点”保留的报文证据条数

/tunables.desc: EXEC plugins running at once per node
/tunables.desc_zh: 每个节点同时运行的 EXEC 插件数上限

/tunables.desc: concurrent probes per node
/tunables.desc_zh: 每个节点的并发探测上限

/tunables.desc: outbound UDP probe packets per second per node
/tunables.desc_zh: 每个节点每秒发出的 UDP 探测包上限

/tunables.desc: PING checks fail when more than this percentage of their echo requests go unanswered, unless the monitor sets loss= (0 = off: only a total loss fails; any loss still marks the check DEGRADED)
/tunables.desc_zh: PING 检查中未收到回复的请求占比超过此百分比时判为故障（监控项可用 loss= 覆盖；0 关闭：只有全部丢失才判故障，有丢包仍显示为性能下降）

/tunables.desc: default grace after a PUSH monitor's period before it is late
/tunables.desc_zh: PUSH 监控超过周期后的默认宽限时间

/tunables.desc: burst for reflective templates
/tunables.desc_zh: 反射类模板允许的突发次数

/tunables.desc: average rate per (target, port, template) for reflective templates
/tunables.desc_zh: 反射类模板对同一目标的平均速率

/tunables.desc: minimum time between the start of two pings or weak UDP checks of the same address on a node, so that the target's limit on ICMP replies does not fake loss or open ports (0 = off)
/tunables.desc_zh: 同一节点上对同一地址的两次 ping 或 UDP 弱检查之间的最短间隔，避免目标对 ICMP 回复的限速造成假丢包或把关闭的端口误判为开放（0 关闭）

/tunables.desc: a monitor with share=yes uses the result of an identical check that started on the same node within this time instead of checking again (0 = never share)
/tunables.desc_zh: 设置了 share=yes 的监控项，若同一节点在此时间内已开始过完全相同的检查，则直接使用其结果，不再重复探测（0 = 不共用）

/tunables.desc: minimum interval (and SOFT retry) for state-creating templates
/tunables.desc_zh: 有状态模板的最小间隔（含 SOFT 重试）

/tunables.desc: 1-hour aggregates
/tunables.desc_zh: 1 小时聚合保留期

/tunables.desc: 5-minute aggregates
/tunables.desc_zh: 5 分钟聚合保留期

/tunables.desc: audit log of permission and configuration changes: set when starting the server (--audit-retention); a value here only ever makes it longer, so the log cannot be cleared from the web
/tunables.desc_zh: 权限与配置变更审计日志保留期：在启动服务器时设置（--audit-retention）；此处的值只会让它变长，因此无法在网页上清除日志

/tunables.desc: events and notification log
/tunables.desc_zh: 事件与通知日志保留期

/tunables.desc: every round's result (latency points, heartbeat detail); uptime comes from the aggregates
/tunables.desc_zh: 每轮检查结果的保留期（延迟明细、心跳明细）；可用率来自聚合数据

/tunables.desc: config snapshots kept
/tunables.desc_zh: 保留的配置快照数

/tunables.desc: status page and badge cache
/tunables.desc_zh: 状态页和徽章缓存时长

/tunables.desc: unconfirmed subscriptions a status page keeps before refusing more
/tunables.desc_zh: 状态页未确认订阅的上限，超过后拒绝新订阅

/tunables.desc: how long resolved announcements stay on a status page
/tunables.desc_zh: 已解决的公告在状态页上保留多久

/tunables.desc: status page subscription requests per client IP
/tunables.desc_zh: 每个来源 IP 订阅状态页的请求速率

/tunables.desc: batched history write interval (the small profile uses 30s)
/tunables.desc_zh: 历史数据批量写入间隔（小硬件档默认 30 秒）

/tunables.desc: a pause longer than this many check intervals counts as a gap (excluded from uptime) rather than the last known state
/tunables.desc_zh: 两次检查之间超过这么多个检查间隔的空白，按缺口处理（不计入可用率），而不是沿用上一次的状态

/tunables.desc: free-disk ratio that triggers retention shrinking
/tunables.desc_zh: 磁盘剩余低于此比例时自动收缩保留期

/tunables.desc: raw retention floor while the disk is low
/tunables.desc_zh: 磁盘不足时原始数据保留期下限

/tunables.desc: persist monitor state snapshots at this interval instead of on every change (0 = on change; small profile 5m)
/tunables.desc_zh: 监控状态快照落盘间隔（0 = 变化即写；小硬件档 5 分钟）

/tunables.desc: writes to the data directory failing this long (full disk, read-only file system) raise a system incident
/tunables.desc_zh: 向数据目录写入持续失败多久（磁盘已满、只读文件系统）后开启系统故障并通知

/tunables.desc: interruptions longer than this send a 'monitoring interrupted' notice
/tunables.desc_zh: 中断超过多久发送“监控中断”通知

/tunables.desc: also notify on clean restarts
/tunables.desc_zh: 正常重启也发送通知

/tunables.desc: rounds needed in the overload window before the ratio is judged
